capabilities.name: whoami
capabilities.summary: Reports the slug, display name, reasoning effort, and context window of the model executing the current turn, so self-identification does not come from training-data memory.

capabilities.name: monitor
capabilities.summary: Runs a long-lived command under the unified exec process manager and streams its output back to the model as batched, sequenced, acknowledgeable notifications, with start/list/read/stop/wait actions.

capabilities.name: background
capabilities.summary: Stop and SubagentStop hook payloads carry a `background` object with live monitor and background-terminal state — what is still running, and how much delivered output was never read — so a hook can refuse to let a turn end on top of work it walked away from.

capabilities.name: skill_activations
capabilities.summary: PreToolUse and PostToolUse hook payloads carry `skill_activations` for the current turn, including each explicit or implicit activation's name, source path, scope, invocation kind, turn id, and content SHA-256.

capabilities.name: show_safety_buffering_ui
capabilities.summary: `tui.show_safety_buffering_ui = false` suppresses the safety-buffering status detail and choice menu. Local presentation only: the same in-flight turn keeps waiting on the same model, with no automatic retry, model or effort change, request cancellation, or change to the server-side safeguard.

capabilities.name: show_prompt_suggestions
capabilities.summary: `tui.show_prompt_suggestions = false` suppresses the composer `Create a plan?` nudge and any future prompt-suggestion surface routed through the same gate. Plan mode and Shift-Tab mode cycling stay available, and `features.tool_suggest` is untouched.
